critical_code_review_comments: ClientReport.jsx line 29: useEffect merges brandingQ.data into local brand state on every change — any later refetch of ['branding'] would overwrite in-progress edits. Mitigation: gate the merge with a 'hydrated' ref so it only runs on first successful fetch, or set staleTime: Infinity on the branding query (already fine today because nothing invalidates ['branding']).
ClientReport.jsx persist() fires a PUT /advisor/branding on every keystroke — fine for small payloads but could be debounced (300ms) to reduce load, especially while typing the cover note.
server.py /report/history: no pagination/limit — report_log can grow unbounded. Consider adding a limit=50 default and a .limit() in the Mongo query. Low priority for MVP.

server.py /advisor/branding GET: returns {} when user has no branding set — frontend handles that fine, but consider defaulting to {firm_name:'Compass Planning', cover_note:'', logo:''} so the shape is always stable.

server.py _goal_behind: 1200-iteration safety cap is correct, but when monthly<=0 and growth<=0 the function returns False even when the target_year is already in the past — a user with current<target and target_year<now will NOT be nudged. Consider: `if ty and ty < now.year and cur < tgt: return True`.
Carryover from iter8 — advisor's Estate 'No will on file' flag casing is now normalised (server.py line 559 uses .lower()); confirmed working.
Repeated carryover: email_service.py still reads EMAIL_KEY/EMAIL_FROM_NAME at import time via os.environ[...] — missing keys crash the whole backend on boot.
test_credentials: advisor@compass.ca / scott@sweston.ca / solo@compass.ca all reset to unenrolled at start of run; this iter re-enrolls them with fresh TOTP secrets. Re-run requires reset snippet from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Advisor branding was reset to {firm_name:'Compass Planning', cover_note:'', logo:''} as cleanup.
seed_data_creation: No persistent new seed data. Pytest+Playwright temporarily created 'TEST_Behind Goal' and 'TEST_Projection Goal' on client_a1 and deleted them at teardown. Report-history now has ~4 delivered@resend.dev rows on client_a1 and 1 on solo (from this + prior iter8 runs) — harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter9_branding_history_nudge.py -v -o addopts=''` (also iter8 file). All 4 iter9 features are green. If 'Invalid authentication code' on login, demo accounts are enrolled with a persistent secret and must be reset via the snippet in /app/memory/test_credentials.md before pytest.
